01

“or a remnant of knowledge”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 46:4).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
or a remnant of knowledge [al-Ahqaf 4] he said: "He says: or anyone who transmits knowledge."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِنْ عِلْمٍ [الأحقاف: 4] قَالَ: «يَقُولُ أَوْ أَحَدٌ يَأْثُرُ عِلْمًا»
Edition record 373354 · p. 602Link to report ↗
02

“He is most knowing of that in which you are engrossed”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 46:8).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
He is most knowing of that in which you are engrossed [al-Ahqaf 8] meaning: "of what you say."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ [الأحقاف: 8] ، يَعْنِي: «بِمَا تَقُولُونَ»
Edition record 373355 · p. 602Link to report ↗
03

“Say, 'I am not something original among the messengers'”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 46:9).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Say, 'I am not something original among the messengers' [al-Ahqaf 9] he said: "He says: I was not the first to be sent."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قُلْ مَا كُنْتُ بِدْعًا مِنَ الرُّسُلِ [الأحقاف: 9] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: مَا كُنْتُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أُرْسِلَ "
Edition record 373356 · p. 602Link to report ↗
04

“and a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 46:10).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something like it [al-Ahqaf 10] he said: "He is Abd God ibn Salam."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَى مِثْلِهِ [الأحقاف: 10] قَالَ: «هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلَامٍ»
Edition record 373357 · p. 602Link to report ↗
05

“His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 46:15).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship [al-Ahqaf 15] meaning: "she carried him with difficulty and bore him with difficulty."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا [الأحقاف: 15] ، يَعْنِي: «حَمَلَتْهُ بِمَشَقَّةٍ وَوَضَعَتْهُ بِمَشَقَّةٍ»
Edition record 373358 · p. 602Link to report ↗
06

“So today you will be recompensed with the punishment of humiliation…”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 46:20).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
So today you will be recompensed with the punishment of humiliation [hun] [al-Ahqaf 20] meaning: "the humiliation [huwan]."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ [الأحقاف: 20] ، يَعْنِي: «الْهَوَانَ»
Edition record 373359 · p. 602Link to report ↗
07
Report from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
"The Ahqaf are sand dunes of Hisma."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الْأَحْقَافُ: خُسَافٌ مِنْ حَسْمِي "

07

“And [mention] when We directed to you a group of the jinn”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 46:29).

08
Explanation from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And [mention] when We directed to you a group of the jinn [al-Ahqaf 29] he said: "The Prophet ﷺ met them that night at Nakhla."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ [الأحقاف: 29] قَالَ: «لَقِيَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لَيْلَتَئِذٍ بِنَخْلَةَ»
Edition record 373361 · p. 603Link to report ↗
